note: Rustic Superior National Forest campground at the end of a forest road on Silver Island Lake, with a boat launch and dock; the launch also serves three boat-in backcountry sites, and a 300-yard portage leads to T Lake. Pack out all garbage. --Claude
summary: Superior NF page read: 8 pull-in sites (FS: 'all 8 sites are longer than 21 feet and may accommodate an RV'), vault toilet, no water or trash, free, first come, May 8-Oct 1. Imagery: loop sites sit 40-80 m back in spruce; one open gravel area reaches the shore but may be the launch. Lakefront -> lakeview proposed. Note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (proposed; default down): the FS publishes no site map or photos, so no site number can be tied to the shore. On Esri z19 imagery the campground loop (~47.7275,-91.1492) has its pads 40-80 m from Silver Island Lake under spruce; the only open ground reaching the water is a gravel area at ~47.7275,-91.1485 (~15-20 m from the shore, three docks along it) that may be the boat launch and backcountry overnight parking rather than a campsite. Stored evidence ('per-site dock access') is not FS wording.

RIG FIT: the FS says only that 'all 8 sites are longer than 21 feet and may accommodate an RV' and 'not specifically designed for RVs'; a 23-ft rig is unclear rather than out (keep with the caveat, AWH 2026-11-02 rule). The old note's 'longer rigs struggle to find level ground' is not on the current page and was dropped.
STATUS: the page shows 'Closed–No fees or services' - the seasonal close after October 1, not a closure; no status set.
PIN 47.72710,-91.15160 is ~200 m W of the loop (~47.7275,-91.1490) and ~180 m W of the FS point 47.72719635,-91.14916709; under 250 m, no move proposed (the FS point is the better pin).
